title: Replace GitHub CI with a local CI gate
acceptance: GitHub CI is absent from the plan and testing docs; cargo xtask ci runs the complete local gate (fmt, clippy, tests, doc -j1, deny, features verify, mdBook, bench, installer-test) and writes a report; scripts/register-local-ci.ps1 is the opt-in nightly scheduler; cargo xtask ci exits 0; evidence recorded.
notes: Stream A of the 2026-11-24 post-0.1.4 close-out plan. Windows only; no GitHub CI.
